summary: Sony Group Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting the disposal of 1,142,196 treasury shares at ¥3,438 per share (total ¥3.927 billion) upon vesting of restricted stock units (RSUs) granted under a stock compensation plan introduced in FY2023. This is a routine equity-settled compensation event, not a special situation. Allottees include directors, officers, and employees of Sony and its affiliates. No board recommendation or advisor was mentioned. The disposal date is August 3, 2026. The filing is equivalent to a U.S. 8-K Item 5.02 (departure of directors or certain officers; election of directors; appointment of certain officers; compensatory arrangements) but is ordinary course.
